name: Khushi Singh
subtitle: BCA Student | Aspiring Java Full Stack Developer
supportingLine: Learning, building, and growing through code.
quote: Turning ideas into meaningful projects through code.
bio:
I am a BCA student with a strong interest in software development and programming. I am currently working towards becoming a Java Full Stack Developer.

I have learned the basics of Java, Python, and C, and I am currently developing my skills in web development, databases, Git/GitHub, and full-stack technologies.

I enjoy coding and building practical projects that solve real-world problems. I am continuously learning new technologies and looking for opportunities to improve my technical and problem-solving skills.
